name: Kahlua Marjoram
original_name: カルーア・マジョラム
source:
Kahlua is a member of the Rune Angel Troupe and her Emblem frame is the Spell Caster. However, Tequila pilots the Spell Caster much more often than Kahlua.

Kahlua has an alternate personality known as Tequila Marjoram. Switching personalities involves a magical transformation that alters her mental and physical characteristics. The transformation is triggered when Kahlua consumes alcohol or a special medicine she makes.

Kahlua has a very quiet nature, and gentle personality. She is also known for speaking in a slow, laidback tone.

She is a descendent of the Marjoram Bloodline, a family of very powerful sorcerers. She is very powerful when it comes to using sorcery, but she is not able to use most of her powers unless she is in emotional distress.

[Edited from [url=http://galaxyangel.wikia.com/wiki/Kahlua_Marjoram]Galaxy Anegl Wiki[/url]]
